title: TheOtherServer
description: A survival multiplayer that is mostly a vanilla experience.
body:
# 📰 SERVER INFORMATION: 📰 # 
Java & Bedrock IP: **TheOtherMinecraft.mcserver.us**
Bedrock Port: **9030**


- The server is on **1.21.11** and is a mostly vanilla experience.
- The server is in **normal** difficulty.
- The server is both available for the Java Edition and Bedrock Edition of the game.
- The server shuts down at 07:00 AM GMT everyday for roughly 30 seconds.
- The world border is set at 20,000 x 20,000

# 📜RULES:📜
- The use of exploits, glitches or bugs is not allowed - this includes duplication.
- Please avoid the use of large automatic farms without the permission of any server manager.
- Hacked clients or mods that allow unfair advantages to gameplay aren't allowed, if caught using one you will be immediately told to remove the mod and if refusal to do so will resort in action from an operator of the server.
- X-Ray resourcepacks are not allowed.
- Using the lands plugin please do not claim over someone else's land, if you are unsure if a territory is within someone's land please contact an admin.

# 💽Plugins:💽 

**Lands**
- You may create up to 3 lands.
- To use the lands plugin use the command /land create. To claim chunks use the command /claim.
- You may join up to 7 lands and add up to 20 members in your land.

**EssentialsX**
- Use /sethome {name} to create a home that will allow you to teleport to it as a waypoint.
- To teleport to the home that you create just use /home {name}  and /delhome {name} to delete the home.
- Members may create up to 3 homes.
- Use /tpa {username} to request a teleport to another player or use /tpahere to request to teleport someone to your current location.

**Bluemap**
- Access the server map here:
[Click Here!](http://theotherminecraft.mcserver.us:9031/)


**Skin Restorer**
- Use /skin update to update your skin to your current chosen one.
Use /skin gui to open the plugins custom skin menu.
